# glasses.text

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Write text at position x, y.

```lua
glasses.text(x, y, font, text)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | unsigned | yes | text horizontal position |
| `y` | unsigned | yes | text vertical position |
| `font` | unsigned | yes | text font ID |
| `text` | string | yes | text |

## Returns

Nothing.

- [active-look](../../examples/official/active-look.md)
